column1: # CORRECTION 2026-08-19: every 'raft linalg/detail/...' path below was wrong; these files live in cuML.

column2: NOT PORTED, AND IT IS THEIR DEFAULT
column3: divide-and-conquer, raft::linalg::eigDC -> cuSOLVER syevd. THIS IS THE ARM cuML's DISPATCH ACTUALLY TAKES: paramsTSVDTemplate::algorithm defaults to COV_EIG_DQ (cuml/cpp/include/cuml/decomposition/params.hpp:53) and the Python layer maps both 'auto' and 'full' onto it (pca.pyx:392-404). We ship the JACOBI arm, which is opt-in for them. syevd is closed cuSOLVER so neither arm is portable; recorded so nobody reads our file as a mirror of their default
one GEMM plus a mean add; trivial once anything needs it
randomized SVD. A different algorithm from the covariance route pcaFit takes, and cuML reaches it only from tsvdFitTransform's rsvd path
a per-component rescale on transform and inverse_transform (pca.cuh:232-242, 292-301); prms.whiten defaults to false

the U-based sign flip. Ours flips on V instead; see DERIVATION_MAP.tsv and the pca.mojo docstring for why, and note that cuML's pcaFit does not flip at all. DEVIATION 525 states our rule as a TOTAL order and pins it once in eig_and_truncate for both PCA and tSVD: largest-absolute-value entry, ties to the LOWEST index (cub::ArgMax's rule, cuML's own tsvd.cuh:160 loop, and np.argmax's), negate iff that entry is < 0.0 so a zero maximum of either sign never flips. Unconditional in BOTH numeric modes: it has been shipped since b495627, so gating it to IDENTICAL would move NUMERIC_FAST bits

theirs computes tSVD's explained variance from the TRANSFORMED data and ratios it against the total column variance of the input (tsvd.cuh:272-293). Ours returns the Gram eigenvalues and ratios them against their own sum, which is a different quantity. tsvdFit itself computes neither

theirs CLAMPS (pca.cuh:123) but only for the seqRoot; truncCompExpVars still truncates with the unclamped prms.n_components, which over-reads. Ours raises. Copying a latent out-of-bounds read is not copying
